'''Hunter Killer''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Hunter Killer}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Tenderizing Goop
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies 1 {{BD2|Tender}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Tender
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Bite
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (17;{{Asc2|9|19}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Puncture
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (7;{{Asc2|9|8}}) damage ×3.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always opens with {{Int2|Hunter Killer|Tenderizing Goop}}. After that, randomly uses {{Int2|Hunter Killer|Bite}} or {{Int2|Hunter Killer|Puncture}}, with {{Int2|Hunter Killer|Puncture}} being twice as likely. {{Int2|Hunter Killer|Bite}} cannot be used twice in a row.

== Notes ==
* The {{BD2|Tender}} debuff reduces {{BD2|Strength}} and {{BD2|Dexterity}} after all of a played card's effects are resolved, so that the damage and {{KW2|Block}} values displayed on cards are accurate.
* Whenever a card's effect plays another card(s) as part of its resolution (such as {{C2|Cascade}} or {{C2|Catastrophe}}) or when a {{KW2|Sly}} card is discarded by a card's effect, that initial card does not resolve until the card(s) it plays have resolved. Thus, {{BD2|Tender}} does not reduce {{BD2|Strength}} and {{BD2|Dexterity}} for that card play until after the other cards are played.
** The player still loses {{BD2|Strength}} and {{BD2|Dexterity}} equal to the total number of cards played in the combo.
** For instance, when playing {{C2|Knife Trap}} to play 2 {{KW|Exhaust|Exhausted|2}} {{C2|Shiv|Shivs}}, {{BD2|Tender}} does not reduce {{BD2|Strength}} and {{BD2|Dexterity}} for {{C2|Knife Trap}} itself until all the played {{C2|Shiv|Shivs}} are played (at which point {{C2|Knife Trap}} resolves). The first {{C2|Shiv}} will deal full damage and trigger {{BD2|Tender}}, and then the second {{C2|Shiv}} will deal 1 less damage and trigger {{BD2|Tender}} again. Afterwards, {{C2|Knife Trap}} resolves and triggers {{BD2|Tender}} for a third time.
